gaps.text: Services outside the building: AC condensers, electricity/water meters, bins, hose bibs, gullies/drains. The model holds none (only two extract-fan duct discharges under the east strip). Needs the client's/MEP drawings.
Surface drainage: falls, gullies, soakaway and water table are not in the model; the yard floor is a flat slab at -3.0.
Ground levels inside the yard are flat by model; real falls, paving build-ups and any steps between garden areas are unknown.

The street gate, its route and the entrance-steps profile are not modelled: the street fence is solid and the shared steps are one solid block (z -1.2..0). Street/steps privacy results are therefore a bound, and the north garden's access from the street is unknown.

Neighbour buildings and their windows are ASSUMED (12 m, windows 'like ours', mirrored plots; villa_env ASSUMPTIONS, client-confirmed as assumptions, not surveyed). So are the apartment's windows (GF repeated +3 m) and the sister's openings (mirror).

Site latitude/longitude: sun layers use villa_env (client maps link, resolved 2026-09-25) - plot-level but not surveyed. spec/villa-site.yaml holds city-level PLACEHOLDER values; sensitivity is reported in sun.json.

Egypt's summer clock (DST, UTC+3) is not in any held source here. 'Summer evening 17:00-20:00' is given on the project's standard time AND as the same clock hours read on a DST clock; the client should say which they mean.

Wind: only the TMYx station record (Cairo West AP, nearest station, ADR-0017). No on-site measurement, no urban/lee modelling, no CFD. Time-Saver 220-12 gives qualitative shelterbelt rules (lee zone 4-6 H) only.

The held 'Site Analysis' book, 'A Pattern Language' and BR 209 are not reachable on this workstation (the knowledge index is empty and no copy is on disk). The checklist is mapped to Time-Saver sec. 220 instead; the book's own checklist pages are NOT cited. Re-run the mapping where the index exists.
Plants, pergola, pots, furniture and the current garden's beds/paths are excluded from every layer (they are the thing being designed). Canopy shade from existing planting does not exist yet.
